title: Anger In Gurbani
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 86
summary: Anger is carried here from third Mehla: toward servant Nanak chants the Naam, and so he lives. Without the Name, he would.
whyItMatters: This shabad is useful when life feels reactive, heated, sharp, because it keeps anger inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private mood.
takeaway: Anger steadies when servant Nanak chants the Naam, and so he lives. Without the Name, he would.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har naam dhiRaiaa tin vichahu bharam chukaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me. It has dispelled my doubts from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਮਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam har keerat gaiee kar chaanan mag dhikhaiaa ||
lines.translation: I sing the Lord's Name and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; the Divine Light shines, and now I see the Way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar ek liv laagee a(n)tar naam vasaiaa ||
lines.translation: Conquering my ego, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord; the Naam has come to dwell within me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurmatee jam joh na saakai saachai naam samaiaa ||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, I cannot be touched by the Messenger of Death. I am absorbed in the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh aape aap varatai karataa jo bhaavai so nai laiaa ||
lines.translation: The Creator Himself is All-pervading everywhere; He links those with whom He is pleased to His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਤਾ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam le taa jeevai bin naavai khin mar jaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak chants the Naam, and so he lives. Without the Name, he would die in an instant. ||2||

structure: The opening movement names the pressure directly: third Mehla:.
The middle movement deepens the correction by holding the mind inside conquering my ego, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord; the Naam has.
The closing movement leaves a return you can actually keep: servant Nanak chants the Naam, and so he lives. Without the Name, he would.
